## Migration purpose

## Guardrails

- [ ] Read CONFENGE ADR-STRAT-002
- [ ] No new SmartLic product, brand, public CTA, indexable surface or independent acquisition
- [ ] No new crawler, DataLake, billing/SaaS or permanent runtime
- [ ] Change is necessary for evidence preservation, safe migration, incident containment or decommissioning
- [ ] Canonical URL, redirect and indexing effects are explicit
- [ ] Tests/checks pass and change is reversible where required
